  • Method Details

    • benefits

      Map<QUser,BigDecimal> benefits()
      Returns a map of benefits associated with each user.
      Returns:
      A map where the key is a QUser object representing a user, and the value is a BigDecimal representing the benefit amount.

    • none

      default boolean none()
      Indicates whether there are no benefits added.
      Returns:
      true if there are no benefits, false otherwise.

    • hasBenefit

      default boolean hasBenefit(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user)
      Checks whether the specified user has a benefit associated with them.
      Parameters:
      user - The user to be checked for benefits. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if the user has a benefit associated with them, false otherwise.

    • willOverflow

      boolean willOverflow(BigDecimal benefit)
      Checks whether the given benefit amount will cause an overflow when added to the existing benefits.
      Parameters:
      benefit - The benefit amount to be checked for overflow. Must be a double value.
      Returns:
      true if adding the benefit amount will cause an overflow, false otherwise.

    • add

      boolean add(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user, BigDecimal percent) throws BenefitOverflowException, BenefitsAlreadyException
      Adds a benefit percentage to the specified user.
      Parameters:
      user - the user to add the specified benefit percentage
      percent - the percentage of benefit to add
      Returns:
      true if the benefit was successfully added, false otherwise
      Throws:
      BenefitOverflowException - if adding the benefit causes an overflow
      BenefitsAlreadyException - if benefits are already added for the user

    • remove

      void remove(@NotNull @NotNull QUser user)
      Removes the specified user from this BenefitManager.
      Parameters:
      user - The QUser object representing the user to be removed.

    • serialize

      @NotNull default @NotNull String serialize()
      Serializes the benefits associated with each user into a JSON string.
      Returns:
      A JSON string representation of the benefits map, where the key is a serialized QUser object and the value is a Double representing the benefit amount.
